summary: Cosmi's Deli (1501 S 8th St, Philadelphia, PA 19147) anchors a 6.0-mile, river-clipped 458-pin South Philadelphia study (291 Pennsylvania home-landmass pins, 167 detached New Jersey pins across the Delaware River) across sandwich shop, hoagie, and cheesesteak. Measured structure highlights three grounded priorities: expanding Cosmi's stronghold hoagie territory into 25 weak-pack pins led by lower-review POPPA WATTS HOAGIES (79 reviews vs 841), closing the 13-pin sandwich shop service gap inside existing hoagie territory against Woodrow's Sandwich Shop, and tightening 0-to-1-mile cheesesteak relevance before chasing distant corridors or crossing the river into New Jersey.

q1.area: South Philly core and Center City seam (0 to 3 mi)
q1.hypothesis: Cosmi's Deli holds 38 top-three hoagie pins but only 7 top-three sandwich shop pins in the same South Philadelphia corridor (13 service-gap pins at mean W 56, plus 31 weak-pack pins at mean W 38). Woodrow's Sandwich Shop (4.6 stars, 1,581 reviews, Pm 2.71, 0.85 mi away) and Big Spence's (4.8 stars, 34 reviews, 99 #1 wins) lead the surrounding blocks.
checkedWebsiteFacts: Observed GBP profile category is Sandwich shop (4.4 stars, 841 reviews, Pm 2.27), matching cosmisdeli.com.
Cosmi's ranks #1 at its home pin on sandwich shop and reaches 69% top-ten coverage inside 1 mile.
nextChecks: Compare Cosmi's GBP menu items, sandwich photography, and homepage copy against Woodrow's Sandwich Shop and Big Spence's.
Exclude the 167 New Jersey pins across the Delaware River (detached landmass C1) and outer pins past 4 miles.
Rescan this same 458-pin lattice in 30 days to measure top-three conversion across the 13 service-gap pins.
q1.success: Convert at least 5 of the 13 sandwich shop service-gap pins into top-three placements inside 2 miles.
